claims.text: Xenical 120 mg PO TID with each main meal containing fat (during or up to 1 h after);
claims.quote: The recommended dose of XENICAL is one 120-mg capsule three times a day with each main meal containing fat (during or up to 1 hour after the meal).
Doses above 120 mg three times a day have not been shown to provide additional benefit.

claims.text: Omit the dose if a meal is missed or has no fat.
claims.quote: If a meal is occasionally missed or contains no fat, the dose of XENICAL can be omitted.
XENICAL may interact with concomitant drugs including cyclosporine, levothyroxine, warfarin, amiodarone, antiepileptic drugs, and antiretroviral drugs
claims.locator: 5.1 Drug Interactions and Decreased Vitamin Absorption

claims.quote: For patients receiving both XENICAL and cyclosporine therapy, administer cyclosporine 3 hours after XENICAL.

claims.quote: Flatus, oily stools, and diarrhea are common but tend to resolve during the 2nd year of treatment.

claims.text: GI effects increase with a high-fat diet (> 30% of calories),
claims.quote: Gastrointestinal events [see Adverse Reactions (6.1) ] may increase when XENICAL is taken with a diet high in fat (>30% total daily calories from fat).

claims.text: so spread fat over three main meals.
claims.quote: The daily intake of fat, carbohydrate, and protein should be distributed over three main meals.
